experiment_requirements.requirement: Randomize the selector uniformly over the eight non-STOP arms at e_t(k|H_t)=1/8 at every branched decision point, and log the propensity with the draw. Frozen: m=9 actions, m_G=8 randomized, delta=1/8=0.125 with m_G*delta=1.000 attained with equality.
experiment_requirements.why: A uniform floor over m_G arms requires m_G*delta<=1, so delta>=0.25 is feasible only for m_G<=4 and is arithmetically incompatible with the frozen 9-action taxonomy. 1/8 is the largest feasible floor.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Do not randomize STOP (A_0). It is exempt from the randomization floor and needs no nuisance model and no GPU.
experiment_requirements.why: Y(A_0 at k)=V_k is H_k^A-measurable given measured verifier determinism (1,954 replicate verifications of 597 repeated (task_uid, sha256(final_code)) pairs, 0 disagreements), so positivity holds by degeneracy; randomizing it at a floor would deplete trajectories geometrically for no information.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Freeze the action set at m=9 and partition it: evaluated A_adm={A0..A5}, diagnostic {A6 DIVERT, A7 MISDIAGNOSE, A8 PATCH}. Diagnostic arms stay in the randomization and in the critic's training data but are barred from every policy, from A_adm, and from every reported baseline value.
experiment_requirements.why: V(e) over the full library is monotone in the number of deliberately degraded arms, so a gap against it is manufacturable with zero learning. The value of a policy that would be allowed A8 is the leakage upper anchor, never the effect of feedback.
experiment_requirements.from_result: T20(c) (R4); findings 1/40; §6 T20(c), §10 D1, §16 items 3 and 14

experiment_requirements.requirement: Make leakage a coordinate of the randomized action: pinned generators q_(g,lambda) built to declared leakage levels by prompt construction, verified offline against the pinned library before the freeze, with the pair (g,lambda) jointly randomized at 1/8. info_cap_bits and suffix_words are frozen action features of the arm, not measured covariates of the message.
experiment_requirements.why: The treatment is the selector and the message is drawn after it, so realized leakage is a descendant of the treatment and a plausible mediator. Randomizing the level makes the lambda main effect and the g x lambda interaction identified by T3 with no conditioning.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Condition on nothing downstream of the selector: no conditioning, stratification, binning, filtering or rejection sampling on realized Lambda-hat, message length, message position, or any function of the outcome. Report Lambda-hat as a per-arm fidelity measurement against the declared level, with the direction of its error stated (it understates leakage, which inflates leakage-controlled contrasts).
experiment_requirements.why: Within-bin contrasts are mediator-stratified and collider-exposed, 'stratify randomization on the bin' is not implementable (the bin is unknown until the action is drawn), and capping Lambda is rejection sampling that replaces q_k by a truncated kernel with an unknown normalizer. A post-treatment-conditioned label is the same defect one step further (P17(a)).

experiment_requirements.requirement: Fix prompt geometry across arms: re-render the task specification at a fixed token distance from the generation point in every arm, padding with inert filler verified at Lambda-hat=0.
experiment_requirements.why: The feedback message is always the most recent context, so a longer message pushes the task specification further from the generation point. Position is caused by the randomized selector and is therefore a mediator; fixing the geometry removes the channel outright and costs nothing.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Run the pre-registered length-calibration block: each class at two pre-registered token budgets plus a filler-only arm (pure context-length increase, no semantic content), about 570 receiver calls, and report class effects net of the measured length main effect.
experiment_requirements.why: Severity and specificity classes differ systematically in token count, so a positive 'severity helps' result is fully explained by 'longer prompt, task spec re-anchored closer to the generation point'. The earlier remedy (a within-Lambda-bin length regression) is a low-power observational regression on post-treatment variables. Without the block the class effect is confounded with length by design-mediation and the text must say so.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Invoke every generator statelessly: fresh process and server session per call, context built deterministically from the recorded H_t and the redacted view X^-; no carried KV cache, persona or scratchpad memory, no surviving reasoning tokens, no persistent tool/retrieval handle, no server-side conversation id.
experiment_requirements.why: Carried state U_t is a function of K_{1:t-1}, hence post-treatment with respect to earlier selectors and a mediator of them, so the generator densities differ between the e-law and the pi-law and do not cancel: T3's identification fails, not merely its computability. This is the default implementation of a multi-turn LLM user, so it must be barred, not assumed away.
experiment_requirements.from_result: A5, T3 proof, P2 (R7); finding 69; §2 A5, §3 T3, §16 item 1

experiment_requirements.requirement: Verify E8 three ways and report all three: (a) byte-exact SHA-256 input-provenance hash per generator call, recomputed offline from the recorded H_t and X^- alone; (b) fresh-context assertion with prompt caching disabled and an explicit cache reset, logged per call; (c) out-of-order replay of a random 2% sample of calls requiring byte-identical output. On any failure, redefine the history to contain the carried state and restate A9's varphi-measurability and every 'no text critic' claim on the enlarged history.
experiment_requirements.why: Input-provenance logging alone is not sufficient to establish statelessness, and the consequence of failure must be stated in advance rather than discovered afterwards. For the frozen template library these tests are CPU-side and effectively free.
experiment_requirements.from_result: A5 verification (R7); finding 69; §16 item 1(a)-(d), §10 A5/A7/A9 rows

experiment_requirements.requirement: Redact by architecture, not by arm: generators receive X^- with the reference solution and tests removed, and signature_example (byte-identical to test_list[0] on 427/427 MBPP tasks) is stripped from every record a generator or the feature builder can reach. Enforce via the same prompt-hash assertion as E9. Answer-visible (A8 PATCH) runs only as a declared positive control in the diagnostic stratum.
experiment_requirements.why: A12/A5 imposed no architectural bar on generators seeing the reference answer or test suite, and 'answer-withheld' appeared only as one arm among many. Without the invariant, 'more informative feedback works better' is true by construction.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Enforce the varphi-exclusion firewall in code: varphi is the frozen 87-coordinate policy-observable map, and build_features must raise on any of {test_list, test, challenge_test_list, reference, signature_example, V, Y}, with a unit test per forbidden key.
experiment_requirements.why: This replaces the withdrawn requirement of 'two prespecified independent measurement channels', which could not be held simultaneously with T8's degeneracy. The real hazard is the policy seeing the grade: a quantity may be available to the estimator (H^A, T8a) and must be unavailable to the policy (F^O, T8b).

experiment_requirements.requirement: Grade psi at every turn, and preserve full-depth data: the branch tree and the full-depth arms (B2/B3a/B3b, charged 2.0 turns) must run to T_max=3. The endogenously stopping live policy arms (charged about 0.63 continuation calls per unit) do not carry grades past their stop, so no other stopping rule's value may be read from their logs.
experiment_requirements.why: The stop coordinate carries no importance weight only when a value is obtained from data recorded to the cap, or by running the regime on-policy. Evaluating one stopping rule from a log generated by a different early-stopping rule would need a weight, and this design must not be allowed to do that by accident.
experiment_requirements.from_result: T8a, R1/R2, and the resolution of spec conflict C4 against docs/design_e3_critic_policy.md §13

experiment_requirements.requirement: Report the oracle-V minus p-hat-rule value gap as a headline pair; never report the oracle value alone.
experiment_requirements.why: The only measured headroom (+4.6 percentage points, 0.691 to 0.737) is the value of an oracle stopping rule available to no real rule, and the implementable stop value E[psi | varphi] is an unknown regression. The visible verdict is one bit and absent on 20.8% of the informative pool, and the sibling loop's own self-check stopped on 0.504 [0.479, 0.528] of all failures.
experiment_requirements.from_result: T8b (R3); audits A3; §16 item 6, §8 requirements item 2

experiment_requirements.requirement: Freeze and hash, before any outcome of this run is examined: the generator library and its evaluated/diagnostic partition; the coarsening map; the leakage scorer; varphi as data; the 176-family file and the 5-fold assignment; the task pool file; lambda=0.01 per turn and the grid {0,0.005,0.01,0.02}; the candidate set Pi with |Pi|=8; the action-feature code (channel, info_cap_bits, carries_verdict_bit, suffix_words, template_index); baselines B0-B7; the primary and ordered secondary outcome list. Record the freeze commit id.
experiment_requirements.why: The reported object is pi-hat = argmax over a pre-registered finite candidate set, and every interval that ranges over that set carries L=log(4|Pi|/alpha)=6.461 at |Pi|=8. A placeholder |Pi|=100 is forbidden, and action features must be declared as features of the arm rather than measured covariates of the message.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Compute G_0 (the mid-rank CDF of u(Z) under the reference regime) from the sibling project's completed 4,488-episode log (ykzeng-yale/DTR-AgentEvals, identical tasks_sha256, verified not assumed), hash it before any outcome of this run is examined, and report the win probability as reference-dependent on that frozen reference.
experiment_requirements.why: Pre-registering the reference regime pi_0 does not pin the functional G_0, which is an unknown feature of P. Estimating it on the analysis sample would make Y-tilde nuisance-carrying and the units dependent, destroy exact unbiasedness, and make Q(.,STOP) an estimated nuisance. The freeze costs zero GPU and zero clusters.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Treat the task instance (task text only) as the i.i.d. unit. Cluster and cross-fit on the 176 task families only: 5 folds, with all seeds, branches, turns, templates and paraphrase variants of a family in one fold. Never cluster by epoch or model-version epoch; if the model version changes mid-run, discard the affected blocks and report them as discarded.
experiment_requirements.why: (task x seed) manufactures unlimited units from a pool whose task text is the dominant variance component (per-task first-attempt success Beta(0.348, 0.230)). A mid-run version change makes the estimand undefined rather than noisy, so an epoch dimension in the variance estimator prices a comparison the document forbids.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Make the paired, common-root, family-clustered contrast (E0) the primary estimator: mean over the 176 families of the family-mean paired difference on the 1,520 paired units (190 tasks x 8 root seeds sharing one saved root O_1), with a paired family-clustered bootstrap. Headline gap against B4; report B2 (fixed unary retry to T_max, mandatory zero-information arm), single-shot no-feedback, and the diagnostics (V(e) on the evaluated stratum, truncated prophet bound) as the other three denominators in one table.
experiment_requirements.why: Measured precision is a half-width of +/-0.019 at R=8 with MDE 0.027 at 80% power; without pairing, power at delta=0.05 against B2 is 0.31 versus >=0.95 with pairing. No weighted formula in the document contains the between-task variance component that pairing removes. B2 breaks one already-correct answer in six (degradation 0.162), so beating B2 is nearly free and B4 must carry the headline.
experiment_requirements.from_result: E0 (R9), T20(d) (R4); finding 21; §16 item 14; conflict C5

experiment_requirements.requirement: Report n_eff in independent task clusters and by entitlement class: Pi_0 (stopping-only, W identically 1, no weighted quantity exists), Pi_1 (W<=8, print ESS and D_2-hat with every number), Pi_2=Pi_cp (W<=64, 2.75 effective clusters, values obtained by on-policy rollout with off-policy certification explicitly disclaimed).
experiment_requirements.why: Override depth is not a free knob: d counts the decision points at which a regime overrides the generator-class distribution, and for full-depth regimes d=D=2 so M=64 and n_eff >= 176*delta^2 = 2.75 clusters. The only measured headroom lives in stopping, which sits in Pi_0 and needs no importance weights at all.
experiment_requirements.from_result: P5, T19, D1 row (R2); findings 35/51; §16 items 8 and 15

experiment_requirements.requirement: Cross-fit every nuisance, including in D1 (A18a is required even when e is known; only the product rate A18b is vacuous), and confine the exact-unbiasedness claim to the cross-fitted one-step/AIPW estimator with an internally consistent V-hat_t = sum_k pi_t Q-hat_t. Do not report TMLE, clipped IPW or self-normalized forms as finite-sample exact, and never use a self-normalized estimator inside a certificate.
experiment_requirements.why: Marking A18 wholesale vacuous in D1 licensed fitting Q-hat on the evaluation fold, which voids the exactness claim it was meant to protect. 'Exactly unbiased for any outcome model whatsoever' is false for same-sample fits and for an independently emitted V-hat.
experiment_requirements.from_result: T9(i)-(ii), A18, E1 (R); findings 53/81; §2 A18, §10 A18 rows

experiment_requirements.requirement: Split selection from evaluation twice. Per state: never report a per-state argmax over branch means as a value (at n_b=3 the inflation is about 0.43, roughly nine times the available headroom), so branch ground truth is used pooled or on strata. Over Pi: re-estimate the winner's value on held-out families and report the selection inflation, with L and the spread across candidates.
experiment_requirements.why: P24(ii)'s corrected rate is Theta(sigma sqrt(log K-bar / n_h)): at n_h=1 the inflation is 0.43 against 0.046 of headroom, at n_h=176 it is about 0.014-0.020, below the MDE and removed by the split. T27's ranking over L candidate learners on the narrow deep slice has the same pathology.
experiment_requirements.from_result: P11, P24(ii), T27 (R16); findings 9/59; §16 item 4, §8 requirements item 4

experiment_requirements.requirement: Report degradation as a separate outcome and never fold it into a mean; stratify on first-attempt status, define the primary estimand conditional on the first attempt failing, and analyse the already-correct stratum separately for harm.
experiment_requirements.why: Measured repair is 0.239 [0.210, 0.270] against degradation 0.162 [0.105, 0.242], so iteration destroys about one already-correct answer in six and a mean-outcome summary hides it. The pool is strongly U-shaped (0.156 of mass below 0.05 success, 0.334 above 0.95, 0.406 informative), so a marginal average effect is the wrong target.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Carry a per-task contamination score (turn-1 pass rate under a no-feedback single shot) as a pre-registered stratification variable, and report cost-priced and prioritized numbers primarily within the uncontaminated stratum with the contaminated stratum shown separately.
experiment_requirements.why: Contamination attenuates content blips but inflates stop-arm advantages and cost-priced gaps (a memorized task is already correct at turn 1, so stopping immediately is genuinely optimal and the learned horizon is biased short), so it is anti-conservative for this design's central coordinate rather than conservative. It also distorts G_0 through the C and N components.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Log the full cost channel separately (prompt/completion tokens, turns, tool calls, latency, money) and price it at the pre-registered lambda=0.01 per turn. If more than one point of the grid {0,0.005,0.01,0.02} is reported, carry a union bound over the grid and call lambda a hyperparameter. A lambda-hat read off an estimated (value, cost) frontier is prohibited. A policy exceeding the primary comparator's mean completion tokens by more than 10% has not met the primary criterion even with a positive point estimate.
experiment_requirements.why: The LP-duality reading makes lambda a functional of P, which would put a data-dependent estimand inside every bound that treats Y - lambda*C as fixed and would void the stated confidence level. It is fixed by fiat instead, and the double-dipping problem is avoided rather than solved.
experiment_requirements.from_result: A10, T8, T20 (R6-adjacent); finding 58; §16 item 13, §15 item 5

experiment_requirements.requirement: Branch hygiene: interleave branch expansions across task instances with a cooldown rather than expanding one node's arms back to back; randomize expansion order, including on the deep slice; replay a fixed-prompt canary battery each block; power the duplicate-arm check on the deep slice specifically; report the duplicate-arm discrepancy beside v-hat and declare v-hat and R-hat unusable if the discrepancy exceeds v-hat. Do not use 'caching changes latency and not tokens' as a check.
experiment_requirements.why: The deep slice repeatedly re-sends near-identical prefixes for one task instance, the maximal-exposure configuration for provider-side prefix/KV caching and batch-level numeric coupling, which no client-side check can rule out. Prefix caching changes kernels and numerics, not token counts, so the token-count check cannot detect the failure it is aimed at, and v-hat would absorb cache-induced dependence as independent Monte Carlo noise.
experiment_requirements.from_result: A1, A13, P18(c) (regraded BC->A); findings 10/30; §16 items 4 and 12

experiment_requirements.requirement: Freeze n_b=3 as a budget decision and report the resolution it buys (per-state Monte Carlo SE up to 0.29 against v-hat about 0.08). Use T27 as a ranking device with L and the spread reported; print an absolute debiased risk only if the matched-slice condition for v-hat is verified (v estimated on a uniform random subsample of the validation histories). Choose any slice width from a pilot estimate of (sigma_e, sigma_m, c_0) against n_b* = max(1, sigma_e*sqrt(c_0)/sigma_m).
experiment_requirements.why: n_b>=8 over 400 states x 8 classes is 25,600 nodes, above the 20,000-call ceiling by itself, and at the ~50 states affordable at n_b=8 R-hat's error is about +/-0.05 and ranks nothing. The earlier 'widest design, n_b=1' conclusion is false in general: the corrected derivative is f' = sigma_m^2 - sigma_e^2*c_0/n_b^2 and the optimum is interior.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Run the falsification battery and publish it with the power of each item stated. Replace the inert-dimension (politeness) negative control with (i) a hash-verified withheld-channel arm whose perturbation is proven absent from the rendered receiver prompt byte-exact (a software-verifiable zero on Y, costing zero receiver calls, whose statistical form audits the pipeline at MDE 0.027) and (ii) A8 PATCH as a guaranteed positive read as the measured ceiling and leakage upper anchor. Do not present a passing battery as evidence of correctness. Hard halt on any failure of the E9 provenance tests, the E11 firewall, or the G2/G3 message gates.
experiment_requirements.why: The politeness control has no valid null inside this framework, which asserts that a frozen receiver is paraphrase-sensitive: a non-zero effect is a true effect on the pinned receiver, not an indictment of the design, and testing an a-priori-false H_0 is uninformative either way. Separately, P18(a) has no power with degenerate weights, P18(b) is not exact under an adaptive design, and P18(c)'s power against subtle state leakage is open.
experiment_requirements.from_result: P18(d), §9 closing claim; findings 6/82; §16 items 10 and 11

experiment_requirements.requirement: Use disjoint rollout sets for Q-hat_t(H_t,K_t) and V-hat_t(H_t); if rollouts are shared, carry the cross-covariance term of order -2*pi_t(K_t|H_t)*E[W_{1:t-1}W_{1:t}]*sigma^2_{Q,t}/m_t before solving the allocation Lagrangian. Include the reach factor P(T>=t) and the roll-in cost in the branch budget constraint, and do not treat 'spend the branching budget late' as a theorem.
experiment_requirements.why: V-hat_t contains the arm-K_t rollout mean that also constitutes Q-hat_t(H_t,K_t), and the two enter the influence function with opposite signs at different weights, so the additive variance display is neither exact nor a bound with shared rollouts and the separate allocation double-counts.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Price every prescription in receiver calls against the 20,000-call affordability ceiling and name the basis of any wall-clock figure: 909 calls/hour for multi-turn 3B work (3.96 s/call, measured on this project's own multi-turn workload), 2,150 calls/hour only for single-attempt work. Cut or mark unaffordable anything above the ceiling. The frozen programme is about 20,151 rollouts (depth-2 supplement 3,200; pilot 1,523; shared roots 1,520; policy continuations 13,908), with the R=12 contingency at 26,428 and the conditional best-of-K arm at +3,800.
experiment_requirements.why: docs/measured_calibration.md marks its own 3.2 s / 2,150-per-hour figures SUPERSEDED for multi-turn work, and states that the 2,150 figure makes multi-turn designs look about 2.4x cheaper than they are. The three available readings of the same measurements differ by 4x (2,150 / ~1,818 / 909 calls per hour), so hours are not a safe unit and calls are.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Do not report as identified or certified: the value of a free-form generative policy, of a generator outside the pinned library, of a late-continuation regime from logs, of a full-depth (Pi_2) regime evaluated off-policy, or of any contrast holding realized leakage, message length or message position fixed. Evaluate such policies by running them and state explicitly what was not estimated.
experiment_requirements.why: Each sits outside a stated boundary: the library boundary (A5/A8), the structural positivity failure for late continuation, the 2.75-effective-cluster limit at full depth, and the post-treatment barrier for mediator-controlled contrasts.
experiment_requirements.from_result: R2, R5, T19(f); §16 item 15, §10 D1 'Not:' clause

experiment_requirements.requirement: Label the simulated-log arm's '0.2' correctly: it is a weight-truncation level (e-hat clipped below at 0.2, so w<=5), not a randomization floor. State that A6 does not hold in that arm (the logging policy is confounded by construction), that clipping bias is introduced, and report the truncation rate.
experiment_requirements.why: 8 x 0.2 = 1.6 > 1, so 0.2 cannot be a randomization floor; carrying it as one would imply a positivity guarantee the arm does not have.

experiment_requirements.requirement: Register the user-kernel dismissibility condition (ISO-U) in the §2 assumption table before any separable-effects or interface-isolation claim is made confirmatorily. If it is tested, the test is: branch on A^D at fixed A^Y in the harness and test invariance of the next-message distribution given continuation. Price that test before prescribing it.
experiment_requirements.why: Only the receiver-side half ('A^D does not enter M directly') is a software guarantee under the byte-exact prompt hash. The claim that A^D affects Y only through the continuation event is about the user kernel, is false in the obvious implementation (a displayed cost meter or progress bar plausibly changes what is written conditional on continuing), and is architecturally false for a simulated intervener unless it is split into two calls with disjoint contexts, at which point the estimand is relative to that artificial split.

open_questions_for_theory: Does the family clustering buy what it claims? The 176 families come from single-link Jaccard >= 0.5 clustering of the 190 E3 prompts (largest family 3; 164 families at threshold 0.4). Whether that threshold delivers approximate independence, and whether power should be quoted at 176 or at 190, is a modelling judgement the pre-registered 0.4/0.6/0.7 robustness row reports but does not settle. Every numerical statement in the repaired §4, §6 and §16 is quoted at 176.

Branch replicates: accept n_b = 3 or re-plan the tree? The corrected P5b algebra gives an interior optimum n_b* = max(1, sigma_e*sqrt(c_0)/sigma_m), plausibly near 10, while the frozen design has 3 and n_b >= 8 is unaffordable (25,600 nodes against a 20,000-call ceiling). Fewer states at higher n_b, pooled-only ground truth, or abandoning the absolute-risk ambition are three different papers.

Is any finite-sample guarantee worth keeping now that T20 is withdrawn? The binding number is a one-sided half-width of 0.254 at n_clusters = 176 against 0.046 of available headroom (5.5x). An anytime-valid bound on Pi_0, where W is identically 1, is available in principle and cannot be narrower than the fixed-sample bound at the same alpha. Carrying no guarantee at all is a defensible alternative and must be chosen deliberately.

T8b is the bottleneck of the deliverable and is not yet a theory. The implementable stop value E[psi | varphi] is an unknown regression; the visible verdict is one bit on MBPP and absent on 20.8% of the informative pool; and the false-pass rate phi = P(visible pass | hidden fail), which governs where a learned critic can beat 'stop iff visible_pass', is unmeasured. The headline deliverable is currently gated on an unmeasured quantity.

Should the greedy-in-varphi rule be a member of Pi at all, given that varphi is not sufficient and backward induction therefore returns it rather than argmax over Pi_cp? And is a covering-number bound for Pi_cp worth deriving? None exists, so no statement about the infinite class can currently be made.

Debiasing P24(i)'s within-unit optimistic bias when the stopping signal and the scorer are correlated by construction remains open for judge-scored secondary outcomes. Neither the clean-independence nor the shared-noise analysis applies, and the document currently offers only the oracle-minus-rule reporting pair as a handle.

Can (ISO-U) be made testable within budget, and is the two-call disjoint-context split acceptable? The falsification test is specified and unpriced, and the split that would make the condition architecturally true redefines the estimand relative to an artificial separation of the intervener's stop head from its message content.

How is the conditional-information leakage scorer validated now that answer-withholding is an architectural invariant? The scorer requires a reference receiver that has seen the reference solution, which sits outside the redaction invariant, and the planted-set dynamic-range validation is specified but its sufficiency is not established.

Is the exceptional-law problem a patch or a re-specification? Roughly half the task mass sits at the boundaries (0.156 below 0.05 success, 0.334 above 0.95). m-out-of-n and adaptive intervals are prescribed, but a primary estimand that is non-regular over half its population may need to be redefined rather than bootstrap-patched.

Confirm the canonical numbering of the binding repair specification (R10-R22). R16 (selection/evaluation splitting), R19 (horizon-invariant scorer), R20 (judge optimism inflation) and R21 (truncated prophet) are cited across the repaired sections; their statements were truncated in transmission and their content was reconstructed from the repaired text. This must be reconciled before the freeze.

Fix the notation obligations: varphi is still overloaded in §11 and A20 (theta'varphi for the tilt basis) against its reserved use as the policy-observable feature map, and the t (turns, 1..3) versus k (decision points, 1..2) index convention must be applied consistently. Editorial, but it touches every displayed weight.

Keep or delete T13/T14? They are demoted to a secondary reporting device on a frozen, reference-dependent G_0, over an outcome with about six cells whose variance is dominated by tie handling, and they shrink an effect already at 0.015-0.030. Deletion is cleaner than demotion and the only cost is a reporting device nobody has asked for.

What survives if A5's out-of-order replay test fails on an LM-generator arm? The prescribed fallback is to redefine the history to contain the carried state, but it has not been worked out which of A9, T3, P2, T9 and the 'no text critic' claims survive on the enlarged history, or whether varphi-measurability can be restored at all.

Should the document be reorganized around the claim the evidence supports? The surviving contributions are the design, honest effect reporting, and the boundary results (adjustment moves reported effects a lot and decisions a little; horizon dominates confounding; repair 0.239 against degradation 0.162; 0.046 from oracle stopping). The document is still organized around identification of blips, which is now the secondary claim.

Is the frozen-reference win probability publishable as such? G_0 comes from a sibling run with its own prompt format and grading, so the reported win probability and pi-star are reference-dependent on a related but not identical regime. The freeze is what buys the theory; whether the resulting estimand survives review is a judgement call.
unresolved_findings: 22 and 41 (major, decision-level confounding claim): CONCEDED, not fixed. The project's own premise checks are evidence against the decision-level claim (39/40 exact optimal regime recovery by a correlational critic, <=0.030 regret gap under hostile latent confounding, non-monotone IPW repair), so causal correction of decisions is demoted to a scoped secondary claim with a pre-registered expected null. The defect in the original motivation remains; only its statement changed.

4 (major, length/position as mediators): CONCEDED in part. Fixed prompt geometry removes the position channel, but the class effect remains confounded with message length by design-mediation unless the separate length-calibration block is run; the document now says so explicitly rather than repairing it.

20 (fatal, T19): CONCEDED as numerically vacuous. The L1 value-loss guarantee is true and useless at every achievable critic precision (honest E|gamma-hat - gamma| of order 0.1 against 0.046 of headroom, with |gamma| mostly below 0.25). The margin form that replaces it is weaker and is reported with the measured |gamma| distribution rather than as a guarantee.

24 (major, exceptional laws): CONCEDED. Non-regularity covers roughly half the population (0.156 + 0.334 of task mass at the boundaries), not a measure-zero corner. m-out-of-n and adaptive intervals are required, but the functional remains non-differentiable over that region.

42 (major, Omega(K^T)): CONCEDED. Structure is an imposed assumption, not a theorem: a learned blip estimator does not evade the query lower bound, it substitutes a function-class assumption that becomes an identifying assumption wherever it extrapolates. Every downstream guarantee is conditional on it.

6 (major, falsification battery): CONCEDED in part. Two known-truth controls replace the invalid politeness null, but no item in the original battery has both a valid null and demonstrated power: P18(a) has none with degenerate weights, P18(b) is not exact under adaptivity, and P18(c)'s power against subtle state leakage is OPEN.
